network: socket connects disabled; no downloads or provider calls permitted
independence_boundary: Authored and frozen from README, module contracts, API documentation, and four original Markdown guides before opening corpus.json, cases.json, evaluator, tests, or service implementation. Existing reported pass counts were not used as expected values. Cases are now public and cease being an unseen holdout after this first evaluation.
scoring_policy: High-certainty cases alone contribute to pass/fail. A relevant extractive answer may state controlling facts instead of deriving a new yes/no sentence. Required groups are case-insensitive source assertions, one alternative per group. Source-section coverage is assessed independently from corpus evidence IDs. Uncertain cases are reported without counted verdict.
additional_scoring_notes: Semantic insufficient accepts insufficient_evidence and needs_review because both abstain.
All expected source sections must be cited; extra sections are recorded but do not by themselves fail a case.
Confident cases require requested source facts, truthful status, no forbidden text, provenance, zero provider calls, and no Relay side effects.
This small public synthetic set is not statistically representative and does not measure generative model quality.
